title: Installation
text: The desktop app, and browser mode for interface work. Oxi runs on your own computer, with no server and no account. Installers are not published yet, so this page covers how developers run it today. The desktop app Oxi is a desktop app: a Rust core with embedded DuckDB, in a Tauri v2 shell with a React interface. Developers can run it from the source repository: Install Rust (stable, with rustup), Node.js 20 or newer

Ask a question Open Explore and type a question in the Ask bar. Choose Ask . Read the answer: the metric chips it used, the metric's status, the result, and the SQL (expand SQL to read it). title: Metric trust
text: Tests, certification and the four metric statuses. Metric trust shows how far each metric's number can be trusted, and what it takes to certify it. Statuses A metric has one of four statuses: Untested : no test has run against it. Tested : its tests passed in the last run. Certified : a person certified it after its tests passed. title: AI settings
text: Choose Claude or Ollama, and see exactly what is sent. Ask can use Claude with your API key, or a model running on your machine through Ollama. Choose a provider Open Settings , choose the AI provider, and turn AI on. Claude : requests go to Anthropic with your API key. Ollama : the model runs on your machine. What is sent Oxi sends the model metadata only: names, labels, descriptions and the dimension values in play

title: Power BI
text: Import a Power BI project (.pbip) into Oxi models and dashboards. Oxi imports a Power BI project into models and dashboards. The preview comes first, and nothing is written until you import. What is imported A Power BI project is a .pbip folder, with TMDL and PBIR files. The preview shows the coverage: how many measures and visuals Oxi translates, and each one it cannot. Import a project Open Models and choose Import

title: Live dashboards
text: Refresh every 1 to 10 seconds, with the Live badge and the last N minutes. A dashboard can refresh itself every 1 to 10 seconds. Turn on refresh Open Dashboards and choose the dashboard. Set the auto-refresh control in the dashboard toolbar, next to Reload, to the interval you want. The Live badge appears and shows when the cards last updated, for example Live · updated 0s ago . Set it back to off to stop refreshing.

title: Workspace files
text: The workspace settings file, the models folder and the dashboards folder. A workspace is a folder. Oxi keeps its settings, models and dashboards as plain files. Layout oxicore.yml : the workspace settings, including the data folders. models/ : semantic models, as dbt-compatible YAML. dashboards/ : dashboards, as YAML. Managed YAML Oxi writes only its own YAML files, and each one starts with the line # managed-by: oxi

title: Security
text: Engine lockdown, connection approvals, secrets and what leaves the machine. Oxi keeps your data on your computer. This page lists what it does, and what it does not do. Local-first Files and the local extract cache stay on your computer. The app sends no usage data, and it has no accounts. Network use happens only for connections you have approved. Engine lockdown The embedded engine is locked after its setup: extern
